svg.title: sovrn art
svg.desc: The whole mark is one field of the programme's own on-chain identifiers — the 15 contracts and inscriptions behind CENTS, Reflection, Nine Reflections, Wunderkammer, Painting with Fire: a history in GANs, Noctilucent Mementi, Possibility Spaces, Sightseers: Perimeter Town, Seasons of Mobility, Latent Couture, byteGANs, RABBIT TAKEOVER, SIGHTSEERS, cope. Vol 1, AI Spaceships. The disc is that field clipped to a circle; the wordmark is the same field, the same characters in the same places, clipped again to the letterforms and coloured gold. Nothing is drawn but text. The technique is taken from Reflection, where the painted forms are filled with the owner's wallet address rather than with colour.

g.font-family: 'IBM Plex Mono', ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, monospace
